dependencies.version_range: any release whose contract declares the tools and flags below (capability detection)

dependencies.install: git clone https://github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5 ~/ACE-Step-1.5 && cd ~/ACE-Step-1.5 && uv sync (Python 3.11-3.12), then fetch the weights once: uv run acestep-download (or huggingface-cli download ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5 --local-dir ~/ACE-Step-1.5/checkpoints); set SOUND_DESIGN_ACESTEP_PYTHON=~/ACE-Step-1.5/.venv/bin/python and SOUND_DESIGN_ACESTEP_CHECKPOINTS=~/ACE-Step-1.5/checkpoints
dependencies.output_use: commercial use of generated music stated by the model card ("You can strictly use the generated music for commercial purposes"); the README asks users to check originality and disclose AI involvement
dependencies.weights_license: MIT (Hugging Face ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5 and the acestep-v15-* / acestep-5Hz-lm-* model cards); bundled text encoder Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B Apache-2.0

dependencies.install: git clone https://github.com/haidog-yaqub/EzAudio ~/EzAudio && python -m venv ~/EzAudio/.venv && ~/EzAudio/.venv/bin/pip install -r ~/EzAudio/requirements.txt (plus torch for your platform), then fetch the weights once: huggingface-cli download OpenSound/EzAudio ckpts/s3/ezaudio_s3_xl.pt ckpts/vae/1m.pt --local-dir ~/EzAudio and huggingface-cli download google/flan-t5-xl (into the Hugging Face cache); set SOUND_DESIGN_EZAUDIO_DIR=~/EzAudio and SOUND_DESIGN_EZAUDIO_PYTHON=~/EzAudio/.venv/bin/python
dependencies.output_use: no statement on the output in the licence, model card or README; MIT places no restriction on use, commercial use included, and no licence read restricts the output
dependencies.version_range: a haidog-yaqub/EzAudio checkout exposing the API read at 86f18268 (capability detection on api/ezaudio.py; EzAudio publishes no version number)
dependencies.weights_license: MIT (Hugging Face OpenSound/EzAudio model card: DiT checkpoints and the waveform VAE); text encoder google/flan-t5-xl Apache-2.0

acestep_tiers: <= 6 GB: 2B turbo DiT only, no LM (INT8 quantization + CPU offload)
8-16 GB: 2B turbo/sft + acestep-5Hz-lm-0.6B (8-12 GB) or 1.7B (12-16 GB)
16-20 GB: 2B sft or XL turbo (XL with CPU offload) + acestep-5Hz-lm-1.7B

acestep.description: ACE-Step 1.5 (2B turbo DiT + optional 5 Hz LM planner): text-to-music, instrumental beds or songs, 10 s to 10 min
acestep.install: git clone https://github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5 ~/ACE-Step-1.5 && cd ~/ACE-Step-1.5 && uv sync (Python 3.11-3.12), then fetch the weights once: uv run acestep-download (or huggingface-cli download ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5 --local-dir ~/ACE-Step-1.5/checkpoints); set SOUND_DESIGN_ACESTEP_PYTHON=~/ACE-Step-1.5/.venv/bin/python and SOUND_DESIGN_ACESTEP_CHECKPOINTS=~/ACE-Step-1.5/checkpoints
acestep.isolation: worker subprocess under ACE-Step's own environment (SOUND_DESIGN_ACESTEP_PYTHON): it pins torch builds per platform, gradio, transformers <4.58 and needs Python 3.11-3.12; this package never imports it
licence_notes: ACE-Step downloads models on first run by itself (Hugging Face, else ModelScope); this skill never lets it: the worker refuses before the checkpoints are complete, replaces ACE-Step's download functions and blocks every non-loopback socket (ADR-004)
the PyPI project `ace-step` (0.1.0, Apache-2.0) is not this release; install from the git checkout
the README disclaimer is guidance, not a licence condition: verify originality, disclose AI involvement
XL (4B DiT) models need >= 12 GB VRAM; not the default here
acestep.lm_status: off: the 5 Hz LM (fine-tuned from Qwen3-0.6B / 1.7B / 4B) is never loaded until the Qwen3 base-model licences are verified (docs/decisions.md ADR-001 follow-up, ADR-004); generation is DiT-only
acestep.output_use: commercial use of generated music stated by the model card ("You can strictly use the generated music for commercial purposes"); the README asks users to check originality and disclose AI involvement
acestep.training_data: model card claim: licensed tracks, royalty-free / public-domain music and MIDI-rendered synthetic audio; the dataset itself is not published (unverified)
acestep.weights_license: MIT (Hugging Face ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5 and the acestep-v15-* / acestep-5Hz-lm-* model cards); bundled text encoder Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B Apache-2.0

ezaudio.confirmation_reason: EzAudio was trained on AudioSet, VGGSound and AudioCaps, YouTube clips whose audio was not licensed for training by its owners. Its MIT licence does not restrict the output, but the owner decided to be told before every use of EzAudio (ADR-007).
ezaudio.confirmation_reason_ja: EzAudio は AudioSet・VGGSound・AudioCaps で学習されています。これらは YouTube の音声で、持ち主から学習用の許諾を得ていません。MIT ライセンスは出力を制限しませんが、EzAudio を使う前に毎回ユーザーに伝えると決めています（ADR-007）。
ezaudio.description: EzAudio-XL (DiT over a 24 kHz waveform-VAE latent, Flan-T5-XL text encoder): text-to-audio sound effects, 1-10 s, mono
ezaudio.install: git clone https://github.com/haidog-yaqub/EzAudio ~/EzAudio && python -m venv ~/EzAudio/.venv && ~/EzAudio/.venv/bin/pip install -r ~/EzAudio/requirements.txt (plus torch for your platform), then fetch the weights once: huggingface-cli download OpenSound/EzAudio ckpts/s3/ezaudio_s3_xl.pt ckpts/vae/1m.pt --local-dir ~/EzAudio and huggingface-cli download google/flan-t5-xl (into the Hugging Face cache); set SOUND_DESIGN_EZAUDIO_DIR=~/EzAudio and SOUND_DESIGN_EZAUDIO_PYTHON=~/EzAudio/.venv/bin/python
ezaudio.isolation: worker subprocess under EzAudio's own environment (SOUND_DESIGN_EZAUDIO_PYTHON): torch, diffusers, transformers, librosa and its other requirements.txt entries are unpinned; this package never imports it
licence_notes: EzAudio downloads a missing checkpoint itself (EzAudio.download_ckpt); this skill passes both checkpoint paths, replaces download_ckpt with a refusal and blocks every non-loopback socket in the worker (ADR-006)
the model card and README say nothing about commercial use of the output; the licences (MIT, Apache-2.0) do not restrict it
the work was done while the first author was an intern at Tencent AI Lab (paper footnote); the weights are published under MIT by the OpenSound organisation
speed, memory use and seed determinism on a real install are unverified (no install here)
ezaudio.output_use: no statement on the output in the licence, model card or README; MIT places no restriction on use, commercial use included, and no licence read restricts the output
ezaudio.output_warning: EzAudio was trained on YouTube audio (AudioSet / VGGSound / AudioCaps); its licences (MIT) do not restrict the output, but the rights in the training audio were not licensed: listen to the effect before publishing (ADR-005)
ezaudio.training_data: AudioSet, VGGSound and AudioCaps (arXiv 2409.10819: DiT stages and the waveform VAE); these datasets are lists of YouTube clips whose audio belongs to the uploaders, not licensed by them for training (risk, not verified either way)
ezaudio.version_range: a haidog-yaqub/EzAudio checkout exposing the API read at 86f18268 (capability detection on api/ezaudio.py; EzAudio publishes no version number)
ezaudio.weights_license: MIT (Hugging Face OpenSound/EzAudio model card: DiT checkpoints and the waveform VAE); text encoder google/flan-t5-xl Apache-2.0

execution.engine_process: worker subprocess in its own process group (under the engine's own interpreter when configured), killed on --timeout; Hugging Face libraries forced offline, engine download functions replaced, every non-loopback socket refused (ADR-004)
execution.offline_flag: accepted everywhere; every registered engine works with no network
execution.overwrites: never unless --overwrite; an output equal to an input is refused

handoff.bgm: audio-production-skill MIX places the generated WAV (with its provenance) under the programme
handoff.cues: audio-production-skill MIX places each cue's file at its start with its gain; the times are the caller's, the skill adds and moves none
handoff.library: audio-production-skill MIX places the fitted library WAV (with its provenance, licence and credit) in the programme
handoff.loop: the editor or audio-production-skill MIX repeats the loop end to end (no crossfade)
handoff.sfx: audio-production-skill MIX places the generated effect (with its provenance) in the programme
handoff.stinger: audio-production-skill MIX places the stinger starting peak_at seconds before the cut

not_provided: mixing BGM / SFX into the programme, ducking, loudness targets (audio-production-skill MIX owns ミックス)
music recognition, licence clearance or copyright checks of generated music
downloading engines or model weights (one-time manual step; doctor says how)
direct ffmpeg calls (every media step is an ffmpeg-skill tool)

policy.confirmation: an engine whose spec names a confirmation_flag (EzAudio: --acknowledge-ezaudio-training-data) is refused with CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED before any work unless the caller passes that flag; an orchestrator surfaces it as a CONFIRM step, tells the user the tool's confirmation.reason, and passes the flag only after the user agrees; the acknowledgement and its time go into provenance.confirmation (ADR-007)
policy.credit: an engine's credit (credit_required) is carried into the provenance and must appear in the published video's description or credits
policy.library_engine: library mode runs no engine (never ACE-Step or EzAudio, no worker) and downloads nothing; every media step is an ffmpeg-skill tool (ADR-008)
policy.library_licence: library mode uses a user file only with a declared licence: library-import refuses a missing, empty or placeholder ("unknown") licence with LICENCE_REQUIRED; library-index reports such files as licence "unknown"; library-pick never chooses them. A declared licence is recorded exactly as declared with verified: false; nothing is inferred or cleared (ADR-008)
policy.output_use: each engine's output-use terms and training-data claim are published in its EngineSpec and copied into the provenance of every file; an engine's output_warning is copied into every result's warnings
policy.shaping: loop-bed and stinger run no engine; they edit a WAV the caller already has through ffmpeg-skill only, measure the result from its samples, and refuse a result that fails its measurement (a loop's wrap, a stinger's peak time and length); the only audio written by this skill itself is digital silence used as stinger padding (ADR-011)
policy.stock_licences: a stock track the user downloaded is imported with its licence (SPDX id or name), the licence URL and / or text (copied into the library's licences/ folder, SHA-256 recorded), title, provider, author, and the source's Content ID statement (registered / not-registered, else unknown); the receipt carries the attribution line (declared, the credit, or composed in TASL order for a CC BY licence from declared parts only) and warns about a Content ID registered track (ADR-014)
policy.watermark: an engine's watermark is never removed or bypassed; it is recorded in the provenance

stock.fetch: not implemented: this skill downloads nothing; download the file and its licence yourself and run library-import with --licence and --licence-url / --licence-file

tools.description: A music bed from a prompt / tags, a target duration and a seed; instrumental unless lyrics are given; validated through ffmpeg-skill/probe and placed with one rename
tools.duration_tolerance: max(0.1 s, 1 % of the requested duration), measured by ffmpeg-skill/probe
inputs: prompt and / or tags (joined into one caption, < 512 characters)

tempo.beat_grid: <output>.beats.json beside the WAV (schema sound-design/beat-grid@1) and tempo_map in the result: every beat, downbeats, bar lines; first beat assumed at 0 s; measured: false (ADR-012)
tempo.duration: with --bpm: the whole number of bars nearest --duration (a half bar rounds up), inside the engine's range, so the bed ends on a bar line

confirmation.reason: EzAudio was trained on AudioSet, VGGSound and AudioCaps, YouTube clips whose audio was not licensed for training by its owners. Its MIT licence does not restrict the output, but the owner decided to be told before every use of EzAudio (ADR-007).
confirmation.reason_ja: EzAudio は AudioSet・VGGSound・AudioCaps で学習されています。これらは YouTube の音声で、持ち主から学習用の許諾を得ていません。MIT ライセンスは出力を制限しませんが、EzAudio を使う前に毎回ユーザーに伝えると決めています（ADR-007）。

tools.description: A sound effect from a prompt / tags, a duration in whole seconds and a seed (EzAudio, mono 24 kHz); validated through ffmpeg-skill/probe and placed with one rename
tools.duration_tolerance: max(0.1 s, 1 % of the requested duration), measured by ffmpeg-skill/probe
inputs: prompt and / or tags (joined, < 512 characters; the text encoder reads 100 tokens)
duration in whole seconds (engine range; EzAudio 1-10)
tools.output_warning: EzAudio was trained on YouTube audio (AudioSet / VGGSound / AudioCaps); its licences (MIT) do not restrict the output, but the rights in the training audio were not licensed: listen to the effect before publishing (ADR-005)

tools.description: Register one user-supplied BGM / SFX file in a library folder with its declared licence (copied in, or registered in place); refuses a missing licence (LICENCE_REQUIRED); measured through ffmpeg-skill probe / loudness; no engine (ADR-008)
inputs: licence (required; SPDX id or the licence text; never inferred)
tools.manifest: sound-library.json at the library root (schema sound-design/library@1), UTF-8, keyed by the library-relative POSIX path in Unicode NFC

tools.description: Every audio file in a library folder with its licence status (declared / unknown: a file without a declared licence is reported as licence "unknown" and never used), kind, tags, mood and the duration measured by ffmpeg-skill/probe (with --loudness, EBU R128 via ffmpeg-skill/loudness --measure-only); read-only

One library file chosen deterministically (declared licence, kind, tags / mood, fit), trimmed or looped with a crossfade to the requested duration through ffmpeg-skill cut / join, validated by ffmpeg-skill/probe, loudness measured, placed as a WAV with its provenance (source SHA-256, the licence as declared, the selection and the fit); no engine (ADR-008)
tools.duration_tolerance: max(0.1 s, 1 % of the requested duration), measured by ffmpeg-skill/probe

fit.loop: shorter and marked loopable: N copies joined by ffmpeg-skill/join with a crossfade (at most a quarter of the file), then cut; at most 64 copies
fit.none: within the tolerance: used whole (PCM WAV copied as is, other formats converted)
fit.trim: longer: the first <duration> seconds, ffmpeg-skill/cut --accurate, no fade (MIX fades)

tools.selection: eligible: declared licence, requested kind, >= 1 requested tag / mood, audio only, fittable; ranked by matched tags + moods, fit (none < trim < loop), |measured - requested| duration, library-relative path, SHA-256

tools.construction: crossfade(source[L, L + x] -> source[0, x]) ++ source[x, L]: the loop's last sample is source[L - 1] and its first source[L]
tools.description: A bed whose end runs seamlessly into its start, for loops in an edit: the loop point is searched near --duration for the place whose continuation best matches the source's start, the continuation is crossfaded into the start (ffmpeg-skill cut / join), and the wrap is measured (click, level, spectrum) and refused if it fails; no engine (ADR-011)
inputs: source WAV (a generate-bgm / library-pick result or the user's file), at least duration + crossfade

tools.description: A transition sound (whoosh, hit, rise) of exactly --duration seconds whose peak (the loudest 10 ms) is at --peak-at seconds, so it lands on the cut: cut through ffmpeg-skill (5 / 10 ms fades where it was cut short), padded with digital silence, re-measured; refused unless the peak is within 10 ms and the length exact; no engine (ADR-011)
Click, level and spectrum across each seam of a WAV (every --period seconds and / or at --seams); exit 1 when a seam fails; read-only. The loop seam check qc-skill does not have (ADR-011)
tools.method: click: the largest 2nd difference within +/- 1 ms of the seam over the 99th percentile within +/- 50 ms; level: RMS of --window seconds on each side; spectrum: octave bands (Welch, 512-point Hann frames of the signal averaged to about 12 kHz) of --window seconds on each side, over bands within 30 dB of the loudest (ADR-011)

align.onset: every other effect (first sample at 10 % of the peak)

tools.description: SFX_CUES: a cue sheet of sound effects (pop, whoosh, ding, ...) at the cut points and emphasis times the caller gives, for audio-production-skill MIX to place: one cue per event at the caller's time (the effect's peak or onset on it), a gain to a stated level, events closer than a minimum spacing dropped, never moved; effects from the library (declared licence) or a named WAV; the skill never decides where an emphasis is and mixes nothing (ADR-013)
inputs: cut times and / or emphasis times (or an events JSON)
library folder and / or NAME=WAV files

tools.description: What is installed and missing (engine, weights, ffmpeg-skill), compute device and GPU memory, and how to get what is missing; never downloads
Registered engines with status, version, licences and output-use terms
